summary.text: Victoria Martz is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 55 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Lindsay Patterson. She is a criminal defense attorney.

paragraphs.text: Victoria Martz was born in Manassas, Virginia, and graduated from Batesville High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Purdue University in 2015 and a law degree from the Indiana University McKinney School of Law in 2018.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up on a small family farm in Milan, Indiana, and works as a criminal defense attorney.
Martz was the Democratic nominee for the same District 55 seat in 2024, when Patterson defeated her in the general election, 80.5% to 19.5%.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.

In the survey, she listed repealing Indiana's Right to Work law, raising the minimum wage, scaling back the school voucher program, legalizing cannabis and banning hyperscale data centers among her priorities.
